resources.string: Feedbrake monitors short-form video scrolls (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook Reels) to track your intake and display live Dynamic Island counters.
Feedbrake widget: Displays today\'s reels watched, time spent, and focus score.
Feedbrake Mini: Compact pill counter for quick reel glance.
Feedbrake Dashboard: Full stats, progress bar, and platform breakdown.
